entities.summary: Katheryn McCormack is a retired ice hockey forward who played for the Mississauga Ice Bears, Oakville Ice, and the Canadian national team. She was a member of the 1998 Canadian Olympic women's team that participated in ice hockey at the 1998 Winter Olympics, winning a silver medal. She played with the Canadian National team from 1997 to 2001.
